items.title: Upload your data
items.desc: Download the Excel template, fill it with your brand's measurements and sizes, and upload it to the dashboard.

items.title: Accurate prediction
items.desc: Neural network with 4 input variables and over 94% accuracy on test data.

items.title: Private data
items.desc: The model trains in the user's browser. No personal data ever leaves their device.

items.title: Responsive
items.desc: The widget adapts to any store: Shopify, WooCommerce, Vtex, or plain HTML.

items.title: Real-time analytics
items.desc: Monitor how many predictions are made, size distribution, and trends by period.

items.title: Customizable
items.desc: Adjust widget colors, text, and styles to match your brand perfectly.
